nodes.name: Two-step hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Porous CeO2 nanorod supports were synthesized using a two-step hydrothermal method with NaOH and Ce(NO3)3⋅6H2O as reactants.
nodes.source_text: Porous CeO2 nanorod supports were synthesized using a two-step hydrothermal method with NaOH and Ce(NO3)3⋅6H2O as reactants

nodes.name: Pt ALD deposition
nodes.procedure: Pt ALD (20-cycle) was performed by the sequential exposure of CeO2 substrates to MeCpPtMe3 (Strem Chemicals, 99%) maintained at 60°C and O3 produced using an O3 generator (CH-ZTW7G-2, Guangzhou Chuanghuan Ozone Electrical Equipment Co., Ltd.). The deposition temperature for Pt was set at 250°C and ultra-high-purity N2 was used as the carrier and purge gas.

The subsequent hydrotreatment at 350°C toward as-prepared Ptn/CeO2 catalyst results in the nearly unchanged parameters.
